skills.name: nexus:nexus
skills.description: Use when the user requests NEXUS generally, status or resumption, or a software engineering task needs coordination across multiple stages. Use a named nexus-* entry directly when the user selects one.

skills.name: nexus:nexus-brainstorming
skills.description: Use when NEXUS brainstorming, discovery, problem framing or comparison of design alternatives is requested, before an approach is settled. Not for executing an already defined plan.

skills.name: nexus:nexus-build
skills.description: Use when NEXUS implementation, refactoring, documentation changes or test creation is requested within an authorized scope or existing plan. Not for analysis-only requests.

skills.name: nexus:nexus-debug
skills.description: Use when NEXUS investigation or correction of a bug, failing test, timeout or unexpected behavior is requested. Not for reviewing a diff without a diagnostic request.

skills.name: nexus:nexus-plan
skills.description: Use when NEXUS planning, implementation steps or architectural contracts are requested for a defined direction. Not for implementing the plan or open-ended brainstorming.

skills.name: nexus:nexus-review
skills.description: Use when NEXUS review of an existing diff, implementation, contract or design is requested. Not for implementing fixes unless the user also requests them, or for open-ended design exploration.
